definition.title: Plan an at-risk release
definition.question: This release is at risk. What can we still commit to?

questions.label: Remaining core validation
questions.question: How much core validation work remains?
questions.meaning: Remaining core QA effort, in whole minutes, across the authored base, independent and integration phases. This bounded profile requires at least 301 minutes; changing the activity structure requires an adapted app.

questions.label: Remaining reporting validation
questions.question: How much reporting validation work remains?
questions.meaning: Remaining reporting QA effort in whole minutes. Reporting is included in the original release; deferring it is an explicit scope revision.

questions.label: Original release deadline
questions.question: When was the complete original release promised?
questions.meaning: The original commitment deadline, in whole minutes from the declared calendar origin. A later proposal does not replace this baseline.

questions.label: Proposed later deadline
questions.question: What later deadline could be accepted?
questions.meaning: A proposed revised release deadline on the same clock. Supplying a date does not establish acceptance of that change.

questions.label: Deadline named in the amendment record
questions.question: Which exact revised deadline does the recorded acceptance cover?
questions.meaning: The precise deadline named in the amendment record, in whole minutes from the same origin. It is operative only when the later-deadline acceptance flag is true and it matches the proposed deadline. A changed proposal does not inherit an earlier acceptance.

questions.label: Additional expense limit
questions.question: How much additional expense is available for a complete arrangement?
questions.meaning: The complete additional-expense limit in USD cents. This is a spending boundary, not a valuation of deferred reporting or delayed delivery.

questions.label: Complete additional-help fee
questions.question: What is the complete fee for the additional qualified help?
questions.meaning: The flat additional expense in USD cents for the authored additional-help arrangement. A low fee does not establish qualification, availability or release permission.

questions.label: Scope revision accepted
questions.question: Has deferring reporting been accepted for this release?
questions.meaning: Recorded acceptance of the specific core-only revision. A passing revised arrangement still does not satisfy the original complete-scope promise.

questions.label: Later deadline accepted
questions.question: Has the proposed later release deadline been accepted?
questions.meaning: Recorded acceptance of the specific later-deadline revision. The original deadline remains visible.

questions.label: Release prerequisites established
questions.question: Are the declared release prerequisites established?
questions.meaning: The scoped prerequisite finding supplied for this build and validation environment. Ticket status is not evidence of this finding. This pilot does not independently assess the underlying records.

questions.label: Recorded release permission
questions.question: Is permission recorded for this release?
questions.meaning: Recorded operating permission for the authored release. The calculation does not authenticate a person or obtain permission.

questions.label: Validation working intervals
questions.question: When can the listed resources perform validation and handoff?
questions.meaning: Complete working intervals on the shared minute clock. Gaps represent unavailable time; effort and elapsed time are different quantities.

questions.label: Scoped validation qualifications
questions.question: Which resources are qualified for this build and environment?
questions.meaning: Qualification intervals must cover the actual work for the authored build and environment. An extra person alone does not establish usable validation capacity.

questions.label: Other resource commitments
questions.question: Which other commitments consume the same resources?
questions.meaning: Retained bookings on the same resource identities and clock. An empty list means none are recorded; missing information must remain unanswered.

brief.question: This release is at risk. What can we still commit to?

value.label: Original scope
value.description: Core functionality and reporting remain in the promised release.

value.scope: A finite comparison of four complete release arrangements using one declared activity structure, scoped qualifications and recorded operating facts.
assumptions: Remaining effort is a reviewed whole-minute estimate; it is not inferred from ticket status or story points.
The authored QA phases distinguish sequential dependencies from work that can be performed by qualified additional help. Effort totals alone do not establish finish times.
Working intervals, qualifications and other commitments refer to the same build, validation environment and clock.
Cost is additional complete expense, not a modeled value of deferred reporting or delayed delivery. No financial or delivery preference is declared.
An unknown required input leaves the whole comparison unresolved. This bounded pilot does not claim partial per-arrangement conclusions or predict delivery probabilities.
